title: Friendship Flag Exchange # 21
summary: On the Inner Wheel Trip to Kolkatta, they performed a flag exchange with the Club of the Past RI President, Shekhar Mehta.
description: On the Inner Wheel Trip to Kolkatta, they performed a flag exchange with the Club of the Past RI President, Shekhar Mehta. This is probably our largest contagion of members who participated in a single exchange - and their beaming smiles say it all. A special thanks to Sps Insiyah Jasdanwalla for painstakingly getting this organized and appreciate her presence as well as that of Rtn Tejal Damani and Spouses Mita Sheth, Manisha Shah, Sejal Shah and Tanvi Parikh .
